project.name: Commit status
project.description: Reports a build back to its commit on GitHub, GitLab or Gitea, through one of two APIs: action=status posts the build state as a commit status (the githubNotify step's behaviour: check credential / repository / commit first, report on the sha the API returns, and optionally comment on a pull request); action=checks publishes a GitHub check run with line-level annotations, in 50-annotation batches, and reads the run and its annotations back.
